item.title: Version 0.2.21
item.description:
Word-wrap for diff views

  • Long lines in unified and side-by-side diffs now wrap to multiple visual rows instead of hiding the tail behind a horizontal scrollbar. Continuation rows share the same line number as their first row (blank gutter on the wraps) so the eye stays oriented.
  • Side-by-side wraps to the tallest side and pads the shorter pane with empty continuation rows, so the two panes — and their gutters — advance in lock-step. No more visual desync when one side has a long Removed line opposite a short Added line.

Short context runs stay inline

  • The context collapser used to fold any run of unchanged lines longer than the visible context. It now keeps runs of 2 lines or fewer inline — a one-line "N unmodified lines" separator was uglier than just showing them.
  • Separator label rewording: "N hidden lines" → "N unmodified lines" — they're not hidden, they're just unchanged.

Revert correctness

  • Revert Change (from the DAG context menu or command palette) now lands the reverse change as a child of the working copy, matching jj revert --onto @. Previously the reverse change was inserted between the target and its parent, which surprised users coming from the CLI and could pull unrelated commits along for the ride.

Internal

  • Split jj-diff's wrap module into a folder mod with focused submodules (cols.rs, chunks.rs, unified.rs, side_by_side.rs, ...); updated AGENTS.md to prefer folder modules over single long-file modules.
  • The macOS app's CLI-path resolver now uses a thread-safe getpwuid_r, filters relative PATH entries, checks the exec bit, and falls back to $SHELL if no login shell is available.

item.title: Version 0.2.20
item.description:
Hunk-level review

  • Mark individual change groups in the diff as reviewed — click the leftmost gutter pill on any line of a group to toggle. Pill is light blue (matching the right-click "Select Change Group" highlight) when unreviewed, solid accent with a white ✓ on the first line when reviewed. Working-copy diffs only.
  • Auto-promotes to file-marked when every change group in a file is reviewed; un-ticking one hunk on a file-marked file demotes only that hunk and keeps every other hunk's review state intact. The file row checkmark in the file column updates immediately.
  • New Hide reviewed files toggle (eye-slash icon) in the file column header — only appears when there are reviewed files to hide.
  • Tracked deletions can be marked reviewed too — identity is derived from the parent's bytes for the deleted file, so re-creating the file or rebasing onto a parent with different bytes invalidates the mark, while a rebase that keeps the same parent bytes preserves it.

Review state survives jj rebases

  • Review marks are now keyed to a per-file content identity computed in the Rust core from the diff's blob IDs. Rebases, amends, and squashes that produce identical bytes keep the marks; an edit to that file (or a rebase that changes the parent bytes for a deletion) invalidates only that file's marks. Marks on one path are no longer cleared by unrelated bytes elsewhere in the change. Old mtime-based entries are silently dropped on first launch.

Diff gutter polish

  • Removed the +/− marker column. The line backgrounds (red for removed, green for added) already convey the same information; the freed space goes to the new review pill.
  • When you right-click "Select Change Group", the system selection highlight now fully owns those rows — the review stripe steps out of the way until selection is dismissed.

GPUI shell (alpha)

  • File column rows widened so the path no longer clips when the filename + path together don't fit a tight row height.
  • Both filename and path now middle-truncate ("shell/mac/…/NativeDiffView.swift") based on the column width — same idea as SwiftUI's truncationMode(.middle). Resize the column wider to see more.
  • Side-by-side and unified diffs both drop the +/− marker column, matching the macOS shell.

Untracked remote bookmarks in the Bookmark Manager

  • Bookmarks that exist only as a remote ref — like feature@origin after jj git fetch when nobody's run jj bookmark track yet — now show up in the Bookmark Manager with a cloud-outline icon, a remote-only badge, and the @origin suffix rendered inline. Closes #55.
  • Right-click on a remote-only row gets you Filter in DAG (with the qualified name@remote so the revset resolves) and one Track name@remote action per available remote — handy for figuring out which collaborator's git branch a head in the DAG belongs to without dropping to the terminal.
  • The stats bar gains a N remote-only counter so you can see at a glance how many untracked branches you've fetched.

Internal

  • Extracted a shared jayjay_core::hash::hex_sha256 helper.
  • Removed old_marker / new_marker from SideBySideRow in the Rust core and uniffi bindings — no consumer left after the gutter rewrite.
  • DiffHunk now carries a canonical review_identity field computed in jayjay_core::repo::diff::entry::compute_review_identity from blob IDs. ReviewStore dropped its disk-hashing path entirely and is now a pure keyed store with caller-supplied identity — same shape Rust-side and Swift-side.
  • jayjay_core::Repo::list_bookmarks now also emits synthetic BookmarkInfo entries (with a new has_local_target: bool field) for remote bookmark names with no local target. Grouped per name; orphan refs are sorted by remote name for determinism.
  • Test suite stopped guarding every real_jj_repo test with redundant jj_is_available() / git_is_available() checks — CI installs both, and silently no-op'ing on missing binaries hid real failures.

item.title: Version 0.2.19
item.description:
Diff fixes

  • Selection clamps to end-of-line. Highlighting no longer trails into empty space past a line's last glyph, and multi-line selections that cross a short→long line transition now highlight every line in full instead of stopping at the previous line's width.

DAG polish

  • Lane connectors now draw short stubs through each node, so the graph reads as one continuous line through commits instead of breaking at every row.

Internal

  • Editor and terminal launch logic moved to jayjay-core (Rust) so the SwiftUI app and the in-progress GPUI shell share one implementation. No behavior change.

item.title: Version 0.2.18
item.description:
Diff polish

  • New Unified / Side-by-side toggle in the diff header — replaces the icon-only toggle so the active mode is unambiguous.

File list polish

  • Tree mode now supports folding directories: click a folder row's chevron to collapse, click again to expand. Fold state is per-window and survives change selection.
  • Hidden the always-on system scrollbar on the DAG and file lists (no behavior change beyond visual quiet).

Fixes

  • Fixed duplicate folder rows in the tree file list — directory entries now carry their full path so SwiftUI's ForEach can key them uniquely.
  • About window: Sponsor / Star on GitHub buttons no longer pick up the macOS default-button accent highlight on open.

Internal

  • DAG lane assignment moved to jayjay_core::dag (Rust). The Swift DAGLayout is now a thin uniffi wrapper, so the lane logic is shared with future shells.
  • jayjay-uniffi split into per-feature modules (dag, diff, error, repo, types); lib.rs is a thin umbrella.

item.title: Version 0.2.17
item.description:
Change evolution viewer

  • Right-click any mutable change in the DAG and pick Show evolution… to see every prior version of that change with operation labels (snapshot, describe, rebase, squash, split, new) and timestamps.
  • Click an entry to interdiff that version against the current head; click a file to see the side-by-side diff using the same engine as the rest of the app.
  • Right-click a row for Copy Commit ID or Copy ‘jj restore’ command — useful for recovering work after a botched rewrite.

Pull Request creation

  • Right-click a non-trunk bookmark (in the DAG row or Bookmark Manager) and pick Pull Request on GitHub to open the existing PR if there is one, or GitHub’s compose URL otherwise. Driven by the gh CLI when present.

Command palette

  • jj is now a first-class prefix alongside !. Type jj st, jj log, jj fix and so on to run the raw CLI with inline output.

Polish

  • Annotate, File History, and Evolution panels share a consistent Done button and esc keyboard shortcut for closing.
  • The Evolution list uses the standard pane background instead of a sidebar vibrancy material that looked off in light mode.
  • Annotate header now shows Annotate: <path> for symmetry with the History panel.

Internal

  • Evolog and file annotate now run in-process via jj_lib::evolution and jj_lib::annotate — no jj CLI shell-out, no template parsing.
  • File history switched to a type-safe revset (RevsetExpression::filter + FilesetExpression::file_path) instead of formatted strings.
  • New DetailPaneMode enum collapses five mutually-exclusive view-state booleans into a single value; annotate and history loaders now guard against stale completions hijacking the pane.

item.title: Version 0.2.16
item.description:
Diff editing

  • Added a grouped diff gutter for multi-line changes, with a dedicated group action column alongside deletion and addition line controls.
  • Change-group actions can now select or abandon a whole contiguous changed block without selecting lines one by one.
  • The group indicator uses a connected mild blue stripe and stays hidden for single-line changes.

Detail view

  • Made the change description area more compact so the diff is visible sooner.
  • Added a lightweight resize handle that previews height changes during drag and applies the layout change when released.

Internal

  • Split diff gutter actions into focused protocols for selection and edit behavior.
  • Cleaned up Clippy warnings in Rust core code.

item.title: Version 0.2.15
item.description:
Working copy fidelity

  • Auto-snapshots now respect Git's full ignore stack — local .gitignore, core.excludesFile, the default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore, and .git/info/exclude. Globally ignored files like .claude/ no longer appear as untracked changes in the working copy.
  • The macOS filesystem watcher now consults the same ignore matcher as the Rust core, so editing a globally-ignored file no longer triggers a stale "uncommitted changes" indicator.
  • Tracked files that match an ignore rule still surface change events, so edits to checked-in build artifacts continue to refresh the UI.

Commit box fix

  • The commit message now resets after a successful jj commit, so the new working copy starts with an empty draft instead of inheriting the previous message.
  • If a commit fails, the draft is preserved — previously the box was cleared optimistically and the message was lost.

Release tooling

  • just release now stops at the local artifact (zip + signed appcast); the new just shell::publish recipe creates the GitHub draft, uploads the zip, and bumps the Homebrew tap. gh release create uses --verify-tag, so publishing aborts cleanly if the v<version> tag has not been pushed.
  • Sparkle signing failures now fail the release outright instead of producing an unsigned appcast entry.

item.title: Version 0.2.13
item.description:
Diff view improvements

  • EOF-newline changes (a file that gains or loses its trailing newline) now render a visible ⊘↵ marker — matches GitHub Desktop. Previously they appeared as plain unchanged content.
  • When Ignore whitespace suppresses every line change, the diff pane now shows a banner instead of silently rendering an all-context view.
  • Files committed as Git LFS pointers no longer spin forever in the image preview when LFS is uninstalled — JayJay detects the pointer bytes and shows the placeholder text path.

DAG and commit box polish

  • Trunk-bookmarked commits (main / master / trunk) now render as diamonds; other bookmarked commits render as hollow accent-stroked circles — easier to scan the graph at a glance.
  • Commit-box drafts survive navigating away from @ and back. Previously the in-progress message was lost whenever another change was selected.
  • Bookmarks in the Detail header now have a copy button, matching the Change and Commit rows.

item.title: Version 0.2.12
item.description:
Drag-to-rebase in the DAG

  • Drag a change directly onto another change to run jj rebase without looking up change IDs
  • Hold-to-arm interaction reduces accidental drags and keeps single-click selection intact
  • Drag hover now shows a clear target outline, node ring, and inline rebase preview
  • Successful drag rebases show a toast with inline conflict follow-up and a one-click Undo action

DAG interaction polish

  • Clicking a change no longer recenters or scroll-jumps the DAG unexpectedly
  • The commit box is only shown for the working copy
  • The Dock menu now includes Open Repository… for faster access

Internal cleanup

  • Repo-level alerts, sheets, HUDs, and toasts now go through a consolidated presentation model
  • DAGRow and DAGView logic moved into focused view models to keep the UI code smaller and easier to test
  • Added macOS app tests for drag-rebase gesture policy and DAG row/view-model regressions, and wired them into CI via just test-app

item.title: Version 0.2.11
item.description:
Status bar + GitHub PR integration

  • New extensible status bar with four item types: plain text, clickable link, action, and picker
  • GitHub PR status via gh CLI — shows PR number, state (open/merged/closed), and checks icon (passing/failing/pending) for the selected change's bookmark
  • Click the PR status to open it in the browser; hover to see the PR title
  • Workspace picker migrated to the new model with nested menu support
  • gh CLI version shown in Settings alongside jj

Post-fetch cleanup for merged PRs

  • After Git Pull, changes that are empty after rebase AND whose remote tracking branch was deleted are auto-abandoned — the PR was already merged, no manual cleanup needed
  • Conflicting changes in the same situation get flagged in the toast message so you can decide

Enum types + serde structs

  • PrState (Open/Closed/Merged), ChecksStatus (Passing/Failing/Pending/None), GhCheckStatus, GhCheckConclusion — all serde-derived, no string comparisons in the parse path
  • JJStatus renamed to CliStatus — shared between jj and gh CLI checks
  • types.rs split into types/ module with 7 focused files

Other fixes

  • Toast dismiss time now scales with message length (2–8 seconds) so long messages are readable
  • Toast tap-to-dismiss works on the full background area, not just the text
  • CI dedup: push trigger restricted to main — PRs no longer run duplicate checks
  • Docs: Myers → Histogram diff algorithm references corrected across README and landing page
  • Fixed broken Roadmap.md link in CONTRIBUTING.md

item.title: Version 0.2.10
item.description:
Diff view fixes

  • Long lines no longer wrap in the unified diff — each diff line is exactly one row so the gutter and content stay aligned. Long lines scroll horizontally instead
  • Row backgrounds (red/green) now fill cleanly edge-to-edge under the no-wrap layout
  • Abandon Selected Lines on the working copy refreshes the diff pane correctly

Rename detection

  • Batch moves (multiple files from one directory to another) are now paired correctly by filename instead of cascade-misassigning on the file list
  • Empty content no longer scores as "identical" — an unrelated deletion in a batch can't steal a rename slot

Working copy auto-refresh

  • Reviewing the working copy + external file save → refresh button shows the pending indicator instead of yanking your selection and scroll mid-review
  • Reviewing another change + working copy change → graph silently updates so the WC entry stays current
  • User actions (Abandon Selected Lines, Describe, Split, …) refresh immediately without a ghost "files changed" flash from the FS echo

Other fixes

  • Repos with many files no longer stuck at loading — fixed a pipe deadlock in the LFS path probe where git's stdout filled up while we were still writing to its stdin
  • Welcome view centers the logo when there are no recent repos; repo list is scrollable when long

Internal

  • Diff rendering extracted into a JayJayDiffUI Swift package — cleaner separation between app glue (DiffSection, DiffStore) and reusable rendering primitives
  • New test target on JayJayDiffUI with regression tests for the no-wrap alignment, background fill width, and rename batching

item.title: Version 0.2.9
item.description:
Image diff rendering

  • PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, BMP, TIFF, ICO, ICNS now render as actual images instead of <binary file> text
  • Side-by-side before/after for modified files; single pane for added, removed, and renamed
  • Pixel dimensions and file size shown under each pane
  • 32×32 icons render at 1:1 — no upscale-blur
  • Checkerboard background for transparent regions

SVG rich-view toggle

  • SVG files keep the text diff by default
  • Eye-icon toggle in the diff header switches to a rendered WKWebView view

DAG + file list keyboard navigation

  • j / ↓ / Ctrl-n → next change
  • k / ↑ / Ctrl-p → previous change
  • Same bindings work in the file list when it's the active pane
  • DAG receives focus on cold launch and new repo windows — no clicking required
  • Multi-window safe — only the key window's DAG responds to keys

Other fixes

  • Settings → Open jj config now respects the configured editor
  • jj fix config uses absolute paths so formatters work regardless of shell
  • Histogram diff algorithm (via similar 3.0) — matches jj diff and reads better on code than Myers

Internal

  • New extensible DiffPreview enum on DiffHunk — adding PDF/video preview is now a single enum variant
  • Test coverage for the image preview pipeline
  • update-appcast.py now prepends new entries instead of clobbering the entire file

item.title: Version 0.2.8
item.description:
What's New

  • Myers diff algorithm — via similar crate, same as GitHub Desktop
  • Divergent commit support — badge, commitId-based actions, resolve option
  • Bookmark Manager — Cmd+Shift+B, stats, filter, clean up, resolve conflicts
  • Commit avatars — GitHub + Gravatar for any email
  • Scrollable descriptions — see full PR messages and Co-authored-by
  • jj-lib 0.40 + tree-sitter 0.26.8

Performance

  • Cargo.lock diff: 15s → instant (Myers O(n*d) vs O(n²) LCS)
  • Preload all file diffs on change selection

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed jj new/jj edit "descendants not rebased" — proper snapshot + rebase lifecycle
  • Fixed multi-window Repository menu dispatching to wrong window
  • Fixed DAG scroll recycling with divergent commits (ForEach identity)

item.title: Version 0.2.7
item.description:
• DiffStore — extracted diff caching and preloading
  • DiffEdit context collapsing — shared Rust implementation
  • Menu icons — SF Symbols on all menus
  • Protocol-based menu system — reliable in all window types
  • Toast HUD dismisses on click

item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
• Auto-track remote bookmarks on git fetch/pull
  • Rebase selected onto context menu action
  • O(n) diff — prefix/suffix trimming for large files
  • Fixed jj edit crash and config check false alarm
